item.description: ### Improved - **Your phone and watch are no longer sent the same usage numbers twice every four seconds.** The Mac republished account usage on every scan whether or not anything had changed, and every connected phone and watch decoded it each time. Usage now goes out only when a number actually moves, and the panel stops redrawing for a scan that found nothing new. - **OpenCode Go usage no longer re-reads your whole OpenCode history while an agent is working.** Every scan used to load and parse every message in the OpenCode database whenever it changed — which, with an agent streaming, was every scan. With a 250,000-message history that was five seconds and 685 MB each time, and it held up every other provider's scan behind it. Perch now asks the database only for the Go messages inside the current windows, and for the billing anchor once every five minutes: under half a second and about 20 MB at the same size. The numbers shown are unchanged.
